en.description:
"Fish Adventure Evolve" - An Independent Apple Watch App, Play with a Lift of Your Wrist

Game Overview:
"Fish Adventure Evolve" is an independent Apple Watch game, designed for quick, on-the-go gameplay. With crown-based controls, you can play anytime, anywhere—perfect for short breaks. Easy to pick up but filled with challenges, you’ll feel the joy of growth as you evolve with every level!

Game Features:
Unique Crown Controls:
Designed specifically for Apple Watch, use the crown to control the fish’s vertical movement. Rotate the crown clockwise to make the fish swim upward, and counterclockwise to swim downward. No need for touch controls, providing the most intuitive gaming experience!

Evolution and Growth:
Start as a small fish, eating smaller or same-level enemies to evolve into a bigger and stronger fish! As you grow, you’ll face increasingly challenging enemies with varying types, speeds, and behaviors. Every evolution brings new challenges and fun.

Challenging Enemies:
The game features various enemy fish, each with different movement patterns and difficulty levels. Only eat enemies of the same level or smaller to continue evolving. Beware! Encountering a higher-level enemy will end the game.

Gradual Difficulty Progression:
The game’s difficulty increases over time as the types, speed, and number of enemy fish steadily grow. You must continually level up and improve your skills to face the escalating challenges.

Immersive Game Experience:
Every time you eat an enemy, your Apple Watch provides haptic feedback and sound effects, letting you feel the satisfaction of every growth milestone. Bigger fish and even more challenges await, delivering a rewarding and immersive experience!

How to Play:
Rotate the Crown:
Rotate the Apple Watch crown to control the fish’s vertical movement.

Eat to Evolve:
Eat enemies of the same or smaller level to gain growth points, level up, and become bigger.

Avoid Bigger Fish:
Stay away from enemies that are stronger than you, survive longer, and aim to score higher.

Ready to take on the challenge?
Join now and become the biggest fish in the ocean!
en.subtitle: Play Anytime On Your Watch

zh.trackName: 大鱼吃小鱼 For Watch — 小鱼历险记进化变大鱼游戏
zh.description:
独立 Apple Watch 应用，《小鱼历险记》抬腕即玩。
支持表冠操作，随时随地开玩，适合碎片时间。
简单上手，却充满挑战，让你每一次进化都能感受到成长的快乐！

游戏特色：
独特的表冠操作：
专为 Apple Watch 设计，利用表冠控制小鱼的上下游动。通过顺时针旋转表冠控制小鱼向上游动，逆时针旋转则向下游动。无需触控屏幕，轻松体验最直观的控制方式！

进化与成长： 从一只小小的鱼开始，吃掉同级或更小的鱼，逐步进化，变得更大更强！随着成长，你将面临更具挑战的敌鱼，且敌鱼的种类和速度逐步增加，每一次的进化都会带来新的挑战和乐趣。
充满挑战的敌鱼： 游戏中有多种敌鱼，每种敌鱼都有不同的移动方式和挑战性。只有吃掉合适的敌鱼才能继续进化。小心！一旦遇到比自己等级更高的敌鱼，游戏就会结束。
渐进的难度： 游戏随着时间推移不断增加难度，敌鱼的种类、速度、数量都会逐渐增加。你需要不断提升自己，才能应对越来越严峻的挑战。
沉浸式游戏体验： 每次吃掉敌鱼时，Apple Watch 会提供震动反馈和音效，让你感受到每一次成长的喜悦。更大的鱼和更多的挑战在等待着你，成就感满满！
操作说明：
旋转表冠：通过旋转 Apple Watch 表冠控制主角鱼的上下游动。
吃鱼进化：吃掉同级或更小的敌鱼，提升成长值，升级变大。
躲避大鱼：避开更大等级的敌鱼，保持生存，尽可能挑战更高分数。

准备好接受挑战了吗？快来加入，成为海洋中的大鱼吧！
